Oneliner

Educational amateur radio mission with 8 identical CubeSats.
Description

The TEVEL2 mission consists of nine 1U satellites (TEVEL2-1, TEVEL2-2, …), developed by the Tel Aviv University New Space Center in Israel and built by a new generation of high school students from different regions of the country.

Each satellite is equipped with dedicated radiation sensors, identical across the fleet, developed by the Soreq Research Center in Israel. From a communication standpoint, the satellites will function similarly to the original TEVEL mission, forming part of the ‘TEVEL network’.

Each CubeSat carries an FM amateur radio transponder. This is an amateur and educational mission, with global amateur participation via FM transponder communication and telemetry reception. Similar to the original TEVEL mission, the FM transponders onboard the satellite will be activated form time to time to allow communication between amateurs.
